notes.title: A welcome, a trailer, and a demo - Perseverence Part 3
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29115981/231783b2686b111d50fc07b4e720f6e466a7d14b.png[/img]

[h2]Hello, drama lovers![/h2]

Hope you’re having a lovely May, we certainly are. We had just released [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1367460/Perseverance_Part_2/]Part 2 of Perseverance[/url] last month and made [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/854870/Perseverance_Part_1/]Part 1 free to play[/url], [b]and we’re already back with more because we just couldn’t wait to share it with you![/b] As you may already know if you’ve watched [b]Feardemic’s Fear Fest[/b], we’ve been working on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1514460/Perseverance_Part_3/]Perseverance: Part 3[/url], and we’re finally ready to spill more tea about what’s next for Jack and Karen. 

As you may have gathered, in this one both of the main characters from the previous entries make a comeback, but, [b]here’s the twist[/b], for the first time, you get to choose which one of them you'd like to experience the story as. It’s also a culmination of a lot of work on this and previous games, so we’re really proud of what we’ve accomplished.

[b]You can read all the deets on the Perseverance: Part 3 Steam Store page or you can watch this brand new Reveal Trailer[/b] we’ve prepared just for this occasion. We’re super thrilled to share this with you, so let us know your thoughts in the comments because we love hearing from you and it gives us the motivation to keep going, and your feedback helps us create a better game. Now, without further ado, the Reveal Trailer for Perseverance: Part 3:

[previewyoutube=vLnJUUWTQ40;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Excited? Hungry for more? Well, we’ve got you covered[/b]. If you simply can’t wait to see what’s coming in the Perseverance series, you can check out the [b]FREE demo[/b] that we have just released. Simply click the Play Game button on the Perseverance: Part 3 Store Page and get right back to Grey Ville for your scheduled drama injection. [b]Oh, and while you’re on that page, don’t forget to add Part 3 to your Wishlist, to make sure you’ll never miss an update or any juicy gossip:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1514460/Perseverance_Part_3/

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29115981/1482a96bd7d90d54abbf6625a6ad3b4ab43ccb7a.jpg[/img]

Speaking of gossip, let us know in the comments and on Twitter, whether you’re [b]#TeamJack[/b] or [b]#TeamKaren[/b], we’re excited to hear who you’ll be playing as! Make sure to tag [b]@feardemic[/b] and [b]@TitaniteNovels[/b] as well so we can see your tweets more easily. If you’d like to talk about the game and argue about which character is better, make sure to hop on [url=https://discord.gg/yTaJkdDKtY]Feardemic Discord[/url] and join the conversation there!


[b]Catch you next time, Fearfolks![/b]

notes.title: Perseverance: Part 2 - Devlog #4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39064683/4c82d8f4e7c6958a798c8a07d9e65f0d4db92b07.png[/img]


[h2][b]Hello friends :)[/b][/h2]

[h3]Perseverance is full of various characters which makes writing the main storyline a blast :-) It’s the chemistry between them, their conflicts, and desires that make for a truly thrilling story.  

A while back we gave you a bit of info on - Murphy. If you’re interested about shy geeky scientist, just [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1367460/view/2919983254408168854]click here[/url] :) [/h3]

                                    [u]                                                                                                [/u]

[h3]Today we want to tell you about Bob because Bob… he’s a piece of work, that one. [/h3]

The guy is tall as a shed and built as if he slays dragons for a living. And there is a bit of truth in it. Our modest petrol station clerk is more than he gives away. Karen, Perseverance: Part 2 main character learns about it first hand.

Robert 'Bob' Abey (which is not his original native name by the way) has escaped to Grey Ville from his previous life. He used to study veterinary medicine and wanted to become a vet. After his father's death, he and his brother took over his business. Since the business was a bit shady, it soon took it’s toll on both brothers.

           [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39064683/329956d9d64c5b75e3e4beb5fd25625c3c1a28ac.gif[/img]

Bob had to leave his home after a nearly fatal fight with his brother. Guns involved. In the end, Bob took over a petrol station inherited from his late uncle. His beef with his brother remains unresolved. 

He has a hand for animals, is a helpful guy, and a real positive spirit in town. No surprise that he’s popular with the ladies. Shy Ellen has a secret crush on Bob while our handsome man remains aloof. 

Did we mention that Bob keeps an over-the-top handgun under his counter? You know, just in case?

                                    [u]                                                                                                [/u]
                                                                                                                       
A few questions, which will help us imagine Bob better where:

[b]What has Bob the greatest hope in? [/b]
In the Cosmos, Bob believes that the time will come for everything, and what is happening is Manitou will, in whom he puts faith.

[b]How would the character be described by a loved one? [/b]
Calm, helpful, withdrawn, reticent.

[b]How would a character be described by a stranger?[/b]
A cheerful guy who doesn't need much to be a happy, reticent Indian leader. A bit naive.

[b]The biggest fear? [/b]
Afraid of being stuck in Grey Ville forever, spending his whole life in a petrol station and wasting his potential.

                                    [u]                                                                                                [/u]

               [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39064683/beb2f36ad66bc0f4698cc01d0468e74cd7b94aaa.png[/img]


How will his relationship with Karen and Ellen unfold? What part is he going to play in Perseverance: Part 2 plot? Will there be a romance or a tragic death?

Add the game to your wishlist and discover for yourself soon.

notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello everyone :)[/b][/h2]

[h3]Can you smell the scent of cakes, the Christmas lights are hanging on every wall and the presents are waiting to be unpacked under the Christmas tree? That's why everyone together - the Titanite Games team - and the residents of the restless Grey Ville wish you a happy Christmas with your loved ones.[/h3]

notes.title: Perseverance: Part 2 - Devlog #4
notes.content:
[h2][b]Oh, Ellen.[/b][/h2]

[h3]If there was one character we immediately fell in love with it’s our clumsy, blonde Natalie’s co-worker - Ellen. There was something pure and innocent about her initial concept and we strongly wanted to make her part of the main plot. But how does a goodhearted, harmless person fit into a mystery horror visual novel?[/h3]

                                                       [u]                                                      [/u]

Ellen is a newcomer to the Perseverance story. As a nurse, she works at the hospital - together with Natalie and other employees. She is someone who stumbles at the least expected moment - and nobody's surprised - that's just how she is. You just don’t let her handle fragile, asian porcelain. ;-)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39064683/4ac5c9b31bc4c7ec9d570ee48f44e993e585a1a7.png[/img]

Extremely delicate and shy, she’s like a feather in the wind. She lets life take her wherever it does... Even though she tries her best to make everyone around her feel good and is very friendly one cannot rub off a feeling of deep loneliness in her. Why would a young, beautiful woman seem so lonely?

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32929210/bad4ba8269bf86e8ebe48777ef51a4d343b224a7.jpg[/img]

She looks happy, but is she? About 30 years old woman quickly notices that the reality is not so colorful - the job she once dreamed of is quickly becoming tired and frustrating. The stress causes her to start visiting the bar more and more often just before going to work. Hard work is one thing - but a traumatic past is another...

          [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32929210/3bde87c076032aa64e93e99a56bfefd4a26ed348.gif[/img]

She might look happy, but is she really? Is the stress of her work pushing her to visit the local bard so often? Or is it something else? 

Ellen looks for her happiness in small pleasures and fashionable accessories: a bright lipstick, a denim jacket, colorful dresses, bandanas, and hairpins. Her appearance stands out from her colleagues. Like a child in a world of grownups: a bit passive, a bit stubborn. 
[b]
What will be her part in the upcoming Perseverance: Part 2 story? How is her relationship with Karen going to unfold? What’s her REAL story? [/b]

                                                       [u]                                                      [/u]

[b]Add Perseverance: Part 2 to your wishlist and find out on your own very soon.[/b]

Regards,
Titanite Games

notes.title: Perseverance: Part 2 - Devlog #3
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello friends :)[/b][/h2]

[h3]We recently wrote about Karen Stamp and also showed you how her creation process looks like. If you haven't seen it, it's worth catching up [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1367460/view/2919983254393674406]here[/url]. [/h3]

                                    [u]                                                                                                [/u]

[h3]Today we want to tell you a bit about the mysterious scientist. [/h3]

Murphy is a 36-year-old graduate of biotechnology and cybernetics. He conducts scientific experiments that are financially supported by the military at Grey Ville base. What are they exatcly? You’ll need to play the game to learn the answer. It’s going to surprise you, that’s a promise! :)

What does he look like? The pic shows his specific body type and sloppy hairstyle. He always wears a hawaiian shirt and a pair of sandals. Despite his harmless image, he is an extremely intelligent and witty person always able to unload a tough situation.

               [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39064683/8d6d4d907d4149f64eac1accc6c912a2bc9d77d5.png[/img]

                                    [u]                                                                                                [/u]

A few questions, which will help you better imagine our mysterious scientist:

[b]What has Murphy the greatest hope in? [/b]
In science, technology, and his own intelligence and rationality.
[b]
How would the character be described by a loved one? [/b]
Open, witty, intelligent, read, distanced.

[b]The biggest drawback of the character? [/b]
Sloppiness, calculating

                                    [u]                                                                                                [/u]

notes.title: Perseverance: Part 2 - Devlog #2
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello friends :)[/b][/h2]

[h3] We have made great progress since the first part of the game was released, and that is also thanks to you. Because of our efforts and your support, we believe that Perseverance: Part 2 is now so unique. Today we will tell you about the process of creating one of the key characters - Karen Stamp. [/h3]

                                    [u]                                                                                                [/u]

[h3]Karen's story has been discussed in the previous [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1367460/view/2936871119024403572]devlog #1[/url]. If you haven't read it, be sure to see it :) [/h3]

The whole process of character creation starts with a concept. After that, we make a lineart and add the right colors. Once the character has been prepared, it should be presented in all emotional states. The same face in every situation would look just bad and unnaturally. 

Emotions and their message in the game have great importance for us, that is why we try to make sure that our game conveys them in the best way. The graphic below shows examples of Karen's faces. As a cold agent, it is not difficult to guess that Karen doesn't smile too often :)

               [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39064683/de69649e2ef3bdc6baf9a71d787fcfdf13a4a4c8.png[/img]

notes.title: Perseverance: Part 2 - Devlog #1
notes.content:
[h2][b]Dear friends,[/b][/h2]

[h3] We are nearly ready to release Perseverance: Part 2. The game will be published under our new brand devoted strictly to visual novels - Titanite Novels. In the meantime, we will publish here a series of devlogs for you.[/h3]

                                    [u]                                                                                                [/u]

[h3]Today we will introduce you to Karen Stamp, the character of the second episode of the horror-drama visual novel game - Perseverance: Part 2.[/h3]

You may know her from the previous episode of our game, where her mysterious and intricate personality was only gently defined. In the second part of our game, you will get to know more about this enigmatic character, you will get to know [b]her dark secrets and experiences[/b] that have changed her personality forever.

Perseverance: Part 2 tells the story of Karen Stamp. As a cold agent, Karen is faithful to the mysterious organization. She tries to be noticed with all her might - in fact, she is only treated as a tool.


               [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39064683/d125eb9632ae2fa69082b54073f198bdf2cc1bfa.gif[/img]


                                    [u]                                                                                                [/u]


In the mysterious town of Grey Ville, she appears suddenly and unexpectedly. She is not yet aware of what awaits her. Her main task will be to track down Jane, a girl who is very important to the agency.

Karen will not only be required to carry out her task but also to face the demons of the past,  that quite eat her from the inside.

Her childhood was not peaceful and colorful, in fact, the opposite. All the incidents that happened to her - as a young girl - have become the foundation of her personality. [b]Can she handle this burden?[/b]

                                    [u]                                                                                                [/u]


               [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39064683/3ea1e19cabe0be1c3969ce006613f1ab994872d4.png[/img]



What happened in her life when she was young?
Why will fate put her capacity for making relationships to the test?
Will she do something she will regret?

[b]There are many questions and even more answers.
Stay tuned and hit add to wishlist button, to be up to date.
[/b]

Regards,
Titanite Games
